cpu_on_prem.break_even: NEVER - electricity cost per request exceeds API price

recommendation: CPU-only AirLLM is NOT economically competitive with cloud API: electricity alone costs $0.0139/request vs API $0.0022/request. A GPU setup (RTX 3080) breaks even at ~8,090 requests/month. AirLLM's real value is CAPABILITY (running models APIs don't expose) and PRIVACY (data never leaves your machine).
